cohort: 4002 singleton pregnancies with a gestational age ≥34 weeks at Sodersjukhuset, Stockholm, during 2009-2010 and 2012-2013
finding: Labor induction using an oral misoprostol solution every second hour resulted in a lower CS rate without negatively affecting maternal or fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: This study found that inducing labor with an oral misoprostol solution every two hours resulted in a lower rate of cesarean sections compared to other methods of labor induction.
